title: Te Tangata i Peia atu i te Rangi
intro: Kei te tū tetahi mea ngaro i te huarahi o te hanganga me te whakakorenga. Ko tā rātou kōrero he kōrero whakapehapeha kāore i rite, me te whakahē nui ki te whakahau a te Atua. Ka pāorooro tā rātou kōwhiringa puta noa i ia whakatipuranga, ka noho hei whakamātautau mō ia wairua i whānau mai ki tēnei ao. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei hoariri mutunga kore?
clues: I reira ahau i tētahi huihuinga nui whakaharahara nō te ao tūroa, i te wā i hangaia ai tētahi mea hou i te paru, ā, i homai he ora ki a ia e te Manawa o te Atawhai.
I hangaia ahau i roto i te mea kotahi e mura ana, he rerekē ki te mea puehu.
I tukuna mai he whakahau ki ahau, ā, i kiia e ahau kei raro iho i taku tūranga.
Ua î roa te teoteo i roto ia’u, e ua patoi u‘ana vau i te pee i taua ture ra.
I tukua mai ki ahau he whakaroa kia tae rā anō ki te Rā kua whakaritea, kia taea ai e au te whai i taku i kī ai, arā, te whakapohehe i ētahi atu.
Ko ahau te hoariri kua whakapuakina mō te hunga katoa e hīkoi ana i te whenua, e kōrero pōhewa ana mō ngā tinihanga, e kukume ana i a rātou kia mawehe atu i te ara tika.
